newsitem.title: UK: Man charged in murder of British athlete's brother.
newsitem.headline: Man charged in murder of British athlete's brother.

text.p: A 32-year-old man was on Saturday charged with murdering the younger brother of British former world and Olympic sprint champion Linford Christie, police said.
Russell Christie, 34, died in hospital early on Friday from stab wounds to the neck sustained in an attack in the Notting Hill area of west London.
Simon Williams, an unemployed man, will appear in court on Monday charged with the murder.
A man and a woman also arrested in connection with the killing were released, a police statement said.
Police officers responding to a report that two men were fighting in the street found Christie lying severely injured. He was taken to a hospital where he was pronounced dead.
Linford Christie, 36, was believed to be training in Sydney, Australia, along with his business partner, the sprint hurdler Colin Jackson, and other athletes.
